name: Grade 5 — Science
subject: science
description: Solar system, human body systems, and ecosystems

questions.question: How many planets are in our solar system?
questions.explanation: There are 8 planets: Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune. Pluto was reclassified as a dwarf planet in 2006.

questions.question: Which is the largest planet in our solar system?
questions.explanation: Jupiter is the largest planet. It is so large that all other planets could fit inside it.

questions.question: Which planet is closest to the Sun?
questions.explanation: Mercury is the closest planet to the Sun. It has extreme temperatures — very hot in the day, very cold at night.

questions.question: How long does it take Earth to orbit the Sun once?
questions.explanation: Earth takes approximately 365.25 days (1 year) to orbit the Sun. The extra 0.25 days is why we have a leap year every 4 years.

questions.question: {{userName}} eats a mango. Which body system breaks it down?
questions.explanation: The digestive system breaks down food into nutrients. It includes the mouth, stomach, small intestine, and large intestine.

questions.question: What body system pumps blood through arteries and veins?
questions.explanation: The circulatory system (heart + blood vessels) pumps blood to deliver oxygen and nutrients to all cells.

questions.question: Which organ filters waste from the blood?
questions.explanation: The kidneys filter waste products from the blood to produce urine. Two kidneys, each about the size of a fist.

questions.question: What is a food web?
options: A spider's web made of food
A single chain of who eats whom
Overlapping food chains in an ecosystem
questions.explanation: A food web shows the complex feeding relationships among organisms in an ecosystem — many interconnected food chains.

questions.question: {{userName}}'s class observes the Moon every night for a month. What pattern do they notice?
options: The Moon gets bigger each night
questions.explanation: The Moon goes through phases (new moon, crescent, quarter, gibbous, full moon) over 29.5 days as we see different portions lit by the Sun.

questions.question: What type of energy does a stretched rubber band have?
questions.explanation: A stretched rubber band has stored elastic potential energy. When released, it converts to kinetic energy.

questions.question: What is the path a planet travels around the Sun called?
questions.explanation: An orbit is the curved path an object takes around a star or planet. Earth's orbit around the Sun is slightly elliptical.

questions.question: Which type of ecosystem is a coral reef?
questions.explanation: Coral reefs are marine ecosystems found in warm, shallow ocean waters. They are among the most biodiverse ecosystems on Earth.
